crossRefs.note: A certain woman, who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by…
Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage…
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made…
As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for…
A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple…
For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

translations.web: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has come to him?” He said, “From childhood.
translations.bsb: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?” “From childhood,” he said.
translations.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
translations.asv: And he asked his father, How long time is it since this hath come unto him? And he said, From a child.
